map.本问卷基于戈尔曼（Goleman）情商五要素模型：自我认知、自我管理、自我激励、: This questionnaire is based on Goleman's five-element EQ model: self-awareness, self-management, self-motivation, empathy and social skills, with 4 items per dimension for 20 items in total. Each item is self-rated on 5 levels from "never" to "always", 1-5 points each, for a total of 0-100; the per-dimension levels and your weakest areas are also given. Everything runs in the browser and no answer is uploaded.
